svg.title: Orthogonal projections of two vectors
svg.desc: $x_1$; $x_2$; $0$; $w'$; $A(2,2)$; $B(-3,2)$; $B'$; $a$; $b$; $-2+x_1+x_2=0$; 2; 2; ORTHOGONAL PROJECTION; $w'=(1,1)$; ON THE NORMAL AXIS; $a_{w'}=\frac{4}{\sqrt{2}}$; $b_{w'}=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$; $B'=(-0.5,-0.5)$; Perpendicular projection
